title: vl01: the count N p(x) in the motivation of the expectation value is stated as exact

legacy.old_text: Wenn dieses Ereignis bei $N$ Messungen vorliegt ($Np(x)$), ergibt sich die Summe der Messwerte mit $\sum_x N p(x) \cdot f(x)$.
legacy.new_text: Die statistische Lesart der Wahrscheinlichkeit lautet nun: Bei vielen Wiederholungen liegt die relative Häufigkeit $h_N(x)$ nahe bei $p(x)$. Das Ergebnis $x$ kommt in $N$ Durchläufen etwa $N p(x)$-mal vor, die Summe der Messwerte ist etwa $\sum_x N p(x) f(x)$, und nach Division durch $N$ steht der Erwartungswert da. Diese Lesart ist eine Deutung und kein Satz dieses Kapitels: In einer einzelnen Messreihe kann $h_N$ von $p$ abweichen.

legacy.old_text: If this event occurs in $N$ measurements ($Np(x)$), the sum of the measured values comes out as $\sum_x N p(x) \cdot f(x)$.
legacy.new_text: The statistical reading of probability now says: with many repetitions the relative frequency $h_N(x)$ lies close to $p(x)$. The outcome $x$ occurs about $N p(x)$ times in $N$ runs, the sum of the measured values is about $\sum_x N p(x) f(x)$, and after division by $N$ the expectation value stands there. This reading is an interpretation and not a theorem of this chapter: in a single series $h_N$ may differ from $p$.

reason: The script says that in N measurements the elementary event x occurs N p(x) times and that the sum of the measured values is the sum of N p(x) f(x). In a finite series of runs the count N(x) is an integer and need not equal N p(x). The new chapter separates what is exact from what is a reading: the relative frequencies h_N(x) = N(x)/N of any series are a weight and the mean of the series is exactly the expectation of f in h_N (c01.eq.haeufigkeit, c01.eq.stichprobenmittel, derived); that h_N is close to p for many repetitions is stated as the statistical reading (c01.cl.lesart, source-backed to the script); what can be proved is the bound of theorem c01.thm.haeufigkeit under the assumption of independent repetitions.
